It is for further information that ONGC has launched Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) system. Po st-launch, all vendor invoices will mandatorily be processed through this system. Hence suppliers are requested to submit all invoices along with supporting documents g enerated through GeM portal through the site https://vims.ongc.co.in/ for Payments. Help documents are available in the portal. 3. MSE Purchase preference:
